metadata.description: Koushan investment & real estate agents (Claude AI 2.0).

plugins.name: furas-opportunity-scout
plugins.description: Scans the Furas (فرص) municipal investment portal for long-term opportunities in Riyadh, Jeddah, Mecca and Medina and publishes an Arabic dashboard; deep-dives an opportunity's كراسة and plots opportunities on Google Maps.

plugins.name: jeddah-market-analyst
plugins.description: Twice-weekly Jeddah real estate market analyst: MOJ Real Estate Exchange deals + every active aqar.fm listing → an Arabic dashboard with district prices, supply ratio and investment signals. Also analyses a single listing.

plugins.name: re-regulatory-monitor
plugins.description: Weekly Saudi real estate regulatory monitor (Umm Al-Qura, REGA, MOMAH): an Arabic decisions library (active / superseded / uncertain) plus one email alert per new decision.
